groups.name: Intent requirement in CLI argument parsing and validation
groups.rationale: Makes --intent a required flag on start, parsing it as a repeatable argument that accumulates values in order, then validates presence before any repository or git work.
groups.watch: The parseStartArgs refactor introduces scanArgs to handle repeatable flags; --intent must not lose values when given multiple times, blank intents are filtered out, and the intent_missing check runs after branch validation but before repoContext so the error emphasizes intent is known only to the agent.

groups.name: Intent storage and retrieval in rounds and sessions
groups.rationale: Records the stated intents on each round so later rounds can carry different intents without disturbing prior approvals, and retrieves current intents for display in session state.
groups.watch: currentIntents reads the latest round's intents, defaulting to empty array for rounds written before this change; the intent field is optional on SessionRound for backward compatibility; intents flow into CreateSessionRequest, openRound, and back through currentIntents on session GET.

groups.name: Documentation and help text
groups.rationale: Explains the intent requirement to agents, with examples showing repetition, and clarifies that intent should state what the branch is for, not list files.
groups.watch: Help messages in README, SKILL.md, spec.md and command-help.ts all carry the intent flag and its purpose; the canonical HELP_START string is updated once and reused, so changes propagate uniformly.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
